verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a first-party models endpoint, `GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{model_id}`. Per the changelog, it returns `max_input_tokens`, `max_tokens` and a `capabilities` object, so an agent can discover the live catalog programmatically. Model ID versioning docs back up how the catalog entries are structured. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the endpoint's behavior, and no published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint

citations.quote: List available Claude models and their details (`GET /v1/models`)
`GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` now return `max_input_tokens`, `max_tokens`, and a `capabilities` object.
